description: This file implements the CompositeSerializable class, which manages serialization and deserialization of a collection of Serializable objects within the cuttlefish namespace.

classes.name: CompositeSerializable
classes.description: A class that handles serialization and deserialization of a collection of Serializable objects.

methods.name: CompositeSerializable
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with a vector of Serializable pointers.

methods.name: SerializedSize
methods.description: Calculates the total size needed to serialize all member objects.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes all member objects into a buffer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes member objects from a buffer.
